name: Leonie Freisinger
headline: Co-Founder & CTO @Dryft | M.Sc. ML & Robotics @ Stanford, UWaterloo & TUM | CDTM | TUM.ai Board
location: San Francisco, United States of America
summary:
I'm a former sports car engineer and ML engineer with 8+ years of SW development experience. 
Most recently I co-developed a deep-learning based forecasting framework with >3 Million downloads at Stanford and led a team of over 100 AI students & researchers as the president of TUM.ai.

Growing up on a farm, I love the outdoors and the physical world. Whether that means fixing cars, building robotic gadgets or hiking Kilimanjaro.

positions.title: ML Engineer & Scientist
positions.description:
NeuralProphet, Sustainable System Lab
As a core developer, maintained and enhanced NeuralProphet (https://neuralprophet.com/), a deep learning software framework for explainable time-series forecasting based on PyTorch with 3+ million downloads.

In parallel, built Test-of- time (https://github.com/ourownstory/test-of-time) a framework streamlined for model evaluation. 
Further, focused my research on "Improving global forecasting models on heterogeneous data using  normalization" and built the experimentation framework HPDNorm (https://github.com/LeonieFreisinger/HPDNorm)

positions.title: Technical Product Developer
positions.description:
The joint open innovation project was a collaboration between Entrix (German energy storage startup) and the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM).

Our five-member multidisciplinary team developed a solution for two-way electric vehicle charging, utilizing blockchain technology. In a span of 13 weeks, we created and tested a working prototype, refining it based on feedback from potential users. My responsibilities included:
• Technical prototyping
• Product testing
• Preparing presentations and pitching (together with the team)
